page: Microsoft Azure M64bds_1_v3 is a memory-optimized virtual machine from the MBDSMediumMemoryv3 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 32 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8473C processor operating at 4.0 GHz. The system is equipped with 1397.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-core ratio of 21.83 GB per core. Local storage is bundled with a capacity of 3072 GB, and the instance is capable of utilizing Premium Storage.

Benchmark results indicate strong capabilities across memory and compute-intensive tasks. The server demonstrates strong memory bandwidth, reaching 4519.69 GB/sec for cached small-block reads and 216.95 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads. CPU performance is supported by Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX-512) and Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX), yielding strong scores in Passmark CPU tests and Geekbench image processing. Database operations are highly efficient, with Redis SET operations achieving 70.71 million operations per second and Passmark database operations scoring in the strong tier.

While the server delivers strong prompt processing speeds for large language models, text generation for larger 70B models is a notable bottleneck, registering in the weak tier at 2.58 tokens per second due to the lack of dedicated GPU hardware. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the high resource density of memory and local storage relative to the 64 vCPUs makes it a qualitatively efficient choice for memory-bound workloads without requiring a transition to more expensive GPU-accelerated tiers. This hardware profile is highly suited for large-scale databases, in-memory caching systems like Redis, data-intensive enterprise applications, and memory-heavy simulation workloads.
description: Microsoft Azure M64bds_1_v3 is a memory-optimized virtual machine powered by a 64-vCPU Intel Xeon 8473C processor running at 4.0 GHz. It features 1397.0 GB of RAM, 3072 GB of local storage, and is Premium Storage capable. Operating on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor, this instance delivers strong memory bandwidth, reaching 4519.69 GB/sec for cached reads, and strong database performance, as evidenced by 70.71 million Redis SET operations per second. While its CPU capabilities are enhanced by AVX-512 and AMX extensions, the lack of a GPU limits its utility for large-scale LLM text generation. Qualitatively, the server offers high resource density for memory-bound tasks, making it an excellent fit for large-scale databases, in-memory caches, and enterprise applications requiring substantial RAM and local storage.
